cand.title: 2027 Toronto International Boat Show
cand.excerpt: Nine-day trade and consumer show at Enercare Centre with 500+ exhibitors, 200+ seminars and an official hotel-rates programme. Exhibitors, speakers and out-of-town attendees are credible lodging prospects; no room block is assumed.
linkedLedgerProgrammes: Toronto International Boat Show — 2027 Toronto International Boat Show

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Melissa Arnott, Event Director, and Katya Sundukova, Account Manager, are verified current exhibitor/sponsor contacts; the 2027 brochure invites contact for space, sponsorship and partner opportunities. Melissa is the primary organizer-routing contact; Katya is relevant for commercial partnerships and exhibitor lodging introductions. Neither is proven to control accommodation contracts. Cynthia Hare, Show Manager, is an additional operations-routing contact, not a verified housing buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed public show: January 16–24, 2027, Enercare Centre, Exhibition Place, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Official daily hours distinguish activity dates from publication dates. Exhibitor move-in is January 11–15; move-out January 24 after closing through January 26, potentially relevant lodging shoulders, not confirmed stays. No official 2028 dates or venue announcement located; do not extrapolate dates.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: Radisson Blu’s 157 rooms cannot house this show exclusively. The 2026 show reported 47,286 visitors; the 2027 brochure markets “47,000+ Qualified Attendees,” not confirmed overnight delegates. Plausible roles are small exhibitor/speaker teams, VIP lodging and limited side meetings, with a sales target of approximately 15–109 peak rooms only as a product-fit range, not evidenced demand. Toronto Harbourfront is relevant to Exhibition Place, but MTCC walkability is not a show-access advantage here; transport to Enercare must be addressed. This is a city-event lodging proposition, not a resort retreat. Meeting/reception use must fit the supplied ballroom limits; verify restaurant/lounge and catering before offering food-and-beverage packages.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced 2027 venue: Enercare Centre, 100 Princes’ Boulevard, Exhibition Place, Toronto, ON M6K 3C3. In Toronto proper and the supplied Exhibition Place territory, not MTCC and not a hotel. This establishes the published venue, not access to a signed venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified 2024, 2025 and 2026 editions all used Enercare Centre, Exhibition Place, Toronto; 2027 returns there. This is demonstrated annual recurrence at a stable Toronto venue, not a destination-rotation opportunity. The reviewed series does not establish its entire historical venue history or a 2028 commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The current 2027 homepage advertises “Show Hotels” and “Official hotel rates” and links to onPeak Compass. The booking page returned “Cookies must be enabled”; its edition-specific inventory and contractual terms could not be verified. Treat onPeak as the organizer-linked reservation channel, not proof of an open hotel RFP or guaranteed blocks. Every hotel in the explicitly labelled 2026 official list: Sheraton Centre Toronto; Westin Harbour Castle; Chelsea Hotel Toronto; Hotel X Toronto. The 2026 kit states these are the “ONLY official hotels for the 2026 Toronto Boat Show” and “exhibitors are to make their reservations directly.” These are historical rate-program incumbents, not proven 2027 commitments. The 2027 brochure contains “Shuttle Bus – Sheraton & Westin Hotels” on a reused floor plan that also bears 2024 text; do not upgrade that reference into 2027 hotel or shuttle confirmation. No open RFP was located.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercially produced boat show, not an association-owned conference assumption. The 2027 exhibitor application and terms identify Canadian Boat Shows Inc. as the operating/contracting entity. A February 2026 trade-publication reproduction of President/Show Director Linda Waddell’s exhibitor letter announces that TIBS joined Informa’s boat-show portfolio and describes a continuing long-term partnership with Boating Ontario Association. Thus distinguish Canadian Boat Shows Inc., Informa’s portfolio ownership, and Boating Ontario’s association relationship. The exact acquiring subsidiary is not established. Enercare Centre is the venue; onPeak is the linked housing platform; neither should be substituted for the event owner. No separate PCO/DMC was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Four established 2026 rate-program competitors are Sheraton Centre Toronto, Westin Harbour Castle, Chelsea Hotel Toronto and Hotel X Toronto. The kit describes Hotel X as “Hotel closest to the Show!” across from the Hall A/B entrances, a location advantage over a Harbourfront alternative. No published sold-out notice, overflow request, room-night total, peak-room count, hotel pickup or guaranteed room allocation was found. Historic attendance and hotel listings cannot establish spillover or addressable overnight demand. 2027 incumbency and onPeak commitments remain unresolved.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Melissa Arnott first and copy Katya Sundukova: request the verified 2027 onPeak hotel roster, housing decision-maker, contracted versus rate-only status, pickup/peak-room data and whether additional hotels or exhibitor-team referrals are accepted. Offer a conditional small-team Harbourfront lodging proposal rather than exclusive show housing, including a transport plan and a request to validate January 11–26 shoulder needs. Confirm hotel inventory and catering capability internally before pricing. If 2027 participation is closed, request a post-show relationship meeting and the next housing review date; do not present 2028 as dated business.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 activity and venue are confirmed; hotel sourcing openness is not. An official rate-program link already exists, so do not pitch as an unsourced headquarters-hotel opportunity. Potential access is conditional: ask the organizer/onPeak about additional-hotel participation or referrals, and approach individual exhibitor teams only without implying official show affiliation. No evidence establishes that all lodging is committed elsewhere, nor that Radisson has available show business.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: repeated January editions at the same Toronto venue make a future preferred-rate/official-program relationship more plausible than relocating the show into this hotel. Develop post-2027 pickup-based discussions for the next cycle, but keep 2028 dates, location commitment and procurement window unconfirmed. This is competitive capture against historical incumbents, not an announced 2028 RFP.
